privacy.notes: These samples preserve observed triage patterns while rewriting wording, dates, names, links, identifiers, and account details. They are suitable for workflow prototyping, not yet evidence of human agreement on real private data.

samples.title: Assignment 3 parts A and B: requirements updated
samples.text: The teaching team has clarified the submission requirements for Assignment 3. Part A remains unchanged, but Part B must now include a short comparison table. The updated specification is available in the course site.

samples.title: Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A session registration
samples.text: A voluntary Q&A session for Assignment 2 Part 3 will be held next week. Students who want to attend should register using the course form before the session reaches capacity.

samples.title: Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A: reminder
samples.text: Reminder: registration for the Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A session closes tomorrow. The session is optional and will not be recorded.

samples.title: Additional Q&A session for Assignment 2 Part 3
samples.text: An additional Q&A session has been opened for Assignment 2 Part 3 after the first session filled. Registration is optional and closes at the end of the day.

samples.title: Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A: final registration notice
samples.text: This is the final notice for the optional Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A. Use the registration form if you need to attend; no registration is needed to submit the assignment.

samples.title: SETU survey reminder and gift-card promotion
samples.text: Students are invited to complete the end-of-unit survey for a chance to enter a gift-card draw. The survey is not described as a course requirement.

samples.title: Peer Student Supporter recruitment
samples.text: The student wellbeing office is recruiting volunteers for a peer-support program. Applications are open to interested students and are unrelated to course assessment.

samples.title: Campus wellbeing day trip promotion
samples.text: A student association is advertising an optional wellbeing day trip during the exam period. Tickets are limited and the message contains no academic requirement.

samples.title: Clayton seminar recording available
samples.text: The teaching team has uploaded a recording of the recent seminar and a copy of the slides. The material is supplementary and no completion action is requested.

samples.title: Scheduled library systems outage
samples.text: Library search and several borrowing services will be unavailable during a scheduled maintenance window this weekend. Students should plan research access around the outage.

samples.title: New sign-in notification
samples.text: A new browser sign-in was detected for the university account. The notice includes a device and approximate location that the account owner should verify. If it was not the owner, the account security steps should be followed immediately.

samples.title: New sign-in notification: duplicate alert
samples.text: A second notification reports the same unfamiliar browser sign-in for the university account. It points to the same security review instructions.

samples.title: Extension application received
samples.text: The university has received an extension request and will review the supporting information. This message confirms receipt only; it does not approve or reject the request.

samples.title: Extension application received: duplicate
samples.text: A duplicate confirmation says the extension request is under review. No outcome or new deadline is stated.

samples.title: Student Barometer survey reminder
samples.text: The university is asking students to complete a voluntary Student Barometer survey before it closes. The message asks for feedback but does not state that completion affects enrolment or grades.

samples.title: Short extension approved for Assignment 4 Part 3
samples.text: A short extension has been approved for Assignment 4 Part 3. The original due time and the revised due time are listed in the notice. Students should check the assessment page before submitting.

samples.title: Short extension approved for Assignment 4 Part 4
samples.text: A short extension has been approved for Assignment 4 Part 4. The revised deadline differs from Part 3, so the student should verify which part the approval covers.

samples.title: Retail account one-time password
samples.text: A shopping service sent a one-time password for an attempted sign-in. The message is unrelated to study and advises the recipient not to share the code.

samples.title: Student election: final voting reminder
samples.text: Students are reminded that voting in an optional student representative election closes today. The message contains candidate information and no academic consequence.

samples.title: Tuition payment deadline changed
samples.text: The student finance office has moved the payment deadline for the next teaching period. Students with an outstanding balance must review the new date and contact finance if they cannot pay on time.

samples.title: Classroom change for the final test
samples.text: The final test will be held in a different room than the one shown in the earlier timetable. Students must use the new room listed in the announcement.

samples.title: Exam timetable room update
samples.text: The university exam timetable now lists the room and check-in instructions for the upcoming exam period. The update affects attendance logistics but does not change the exam date.

samples.title: Counselling appointment confirmation
samples.text: A counselling service confirms an appointment time and asks the student to reply if the time no longer works. The appointment is private and unrelated to course requirements.

samples.title: Course announcement: optional practice questions
samples.text: The teaching team has posted a set of optional practice questions for the next topic. The questions are for revision and are not collected or graded.

samples.title: Final test: last sitting and room details
samples.text: The final test has one remaining sitting. The message gives the date and room and reminds students that passing the test is required to pass the unit.

samples.title: Where should the consolidated code be uploaded?
samples.text: A student asks whether the consolidated source code should be placed in the PDF, the ZIP archive, or both because the submission form shows only two upload slots. A staff reply says to include it in the ZIP and use the PDF for the report.

samples.title: Week 12 task: password storage notes
samples.text: A student posts draft notes explaining salted password hashing and slow password-hashing functions. No question about assessment requirements is asked and no staff reply is present.

samples.title: Week 10 task: PKI explanation
samples.text: A student shares a draft explanation of public-key infrastructure and certificate authorities as part of a weekly learning task. The post has no staff correction or deadline change.

samples.title: Can a member initialisation list set a constant?
samples.text: A student asks whether a constructor member initialisation list can set an instance constant. A staff reply confirms the pattern and points to a language reference example.

samples.title: Attempt at an exam proof
samples.text: A student posts an attempted proof for a past exam question. Other students can use it for revision, but the post is not an official solution and no staff answer is attached.

samples.title: Career task: security analyst role notes
samples.text: A student shares notes about a security analyst job description while completing a career-related learning task. The post does not change the task requirements or request a staff decision.

samples.title: Question about a logic equivalence proof
samples.text: A student asks whether a proposed transformation proves a logic equivalence. No staff or tutor response has been posted yet, so the correctness of the approach is unresolved.

samples.title: Is a six-minute presentation acceptable?
samples.text: A student asks whether a presentation shorter than the stated maximum is acceptable. A staff response says the maximum is not a minimum and reminds students to cover all required points.

samples.title: Assignment 4 Part 2 slide structure
samples.text: A student asks whether the required points for Assignment 4 Part 2 can be paraphrased on slides and whether evidence must be shown for every point. No official answer is visible yet.

samples.title: Question about secure password storage
samples.text: A student asks whether a password manager or salted hashing should be discussed in the weekly answer. The thread contains peer suggestions but no staff conclusion.

samples.title: Can I pass after failing the unit hurdle?
samples.text: A student asks whether a high exam result can compensate for failing the in-semester hurdle. A staff reply explains that the hurdle is a separate pass condition.

samples.title: Week 12 wrap-up and seminar recording
samples.text: A staff announcement links a final seminar recording and invites general feedback about the unit. It does not introduce a new assessment requirement or deadline.

samples.title: Can an AI assistant be cited as a reference?
samples.text: A student asks whether an AI assistant can be included as a reference for Assignment 4 Part 2. A staff reply says the answer depends on the assessment's source rules and points to the referencing section.

samples.title: Week 9 future internet prediction
samples.text: A student posts a speculative response about how internet infrastructure may change in the future. The post is part of a learning task and has no staff feedback.

samples.title: Student explanation of password hashing
samples.text: A student posts a second explanation of salted password hashing for a weekly task. It is similar to another student discussion but is not an official answer.

samples.title: Can the presentation video exceed eight minutes?
samples.text: A student says the presentation is over the eight-minute maximum because of pauses. A staff reply says the submission must be edited to meet the maximum duration.

samples.title: Final test: last sitting and room details
samples.text: A staff announcement states that the final test has one remaining sitting, gives the date and room, and reminds students that passing the test is required to pass the unit.

samples.title: Updated link for today's Q&A session
samples.text: A staff announcement says the original video-conference link is unreliable and gives a replacement link for a Q&A session happening later today.

samples.title: How will the honours interview be scheduled?
samples.text: A student asks whether an interview time will appear in the learning platform or the university timetable. No staff response has been posted, so the scheduling process remains uncertain.

samples.title: Do global constants count as global variables?
samples.text: A student asks whether a project restriction on global variables also prohibits global constants. A staff reply says the restriction applies to mutable global state, but the student should follow the exact project specification.

samples.title: SETU and practice-exam reminders
samples.text: A staff post reminds students about the optional SETU survey and links several practice exams. The post does not state that the survey is required or graded.

samples.title: Video submission guidelines not in the specification
samples.text: A student asks for guidance about how long each slide should remain visible and whether the speaker must appear on camera. No staff answer has been posted.

samples.title: Exact H2 feedback deadline
samples.text: A student asks whether the feedback deadline means the end of Sunday or an earlier time. A staff reply confirms the exact local cutoff and says late feedback requests cannot be guaranteed.

samples.title: Question about the reflective quiz format
samples.text: A student asks whether a reflective quiz permits multiple attempts and whether only the highest attempt counts. No teaching-team answer is present.

samples.title: Article link cannot be opened by the AI tool
samples.text: A student says the article link required for a learning task is blocked by the AI tool and asks whether a downloaded copy can be used. No staff answer is visible.

samples.title: Assignment 4 Part 1 submission deadline
samples.text: The course assessment page lists the submission deadline for Assignment 4 Part 1 as 11:55 pm on the published date. The item is an official system record of a due time.

samples.title: Assignment 4 Part 2 submission deadline
samples.text: The course assessment page lists the submission deadline for Assignment 4 Part 2 as 11:55 pm on the published date. The item is an official system record of a due time.

samples.title: Assignment 4 Part 3 submission deadline override
samples.text: The course assessment page shows a due-date override for Assignment 4 Part 3. The override changes the submission deadline shown for the student and should take precedence over the earlier date.

samples.title: Assignment 4 Part 4 submission deadline override
samples.text: The course assessment page shows a due-date override for Assignment 4 Part 4. The override changes the submission deadline shown for the student and should take precedence over the earlier date.

samples.title: Self-reflective question quiz closing time
samples.text: The course quiz page lists a closing time for the self-reflective question activity. Students who intend to complete it must submit before the closing time; the item does not state that late attempts are accepted.
